:::{#def-inner-product}
#### Inner product

An **inner product**
[@wikipedia_inner_product_space]
on $\reals^p$ is a function $\iprod{\cdot}{\cdot}$
that assigns a [real number](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers) to each ordered pair of vectors in $\reals^p$
and that has the following four properties:

- [positivity](#def-inner-product-positivity);
- [definiteness](#def-inner-product-definiteness);
- [linearity in the first slot](#def-inner-product-linearity);
- [symmetry](#def-inner-product-symmetry).

:::
